facts.fact: Raxio Group operates carrier-neutral colocation data centres in Luanda that host customers, and AFR-IX Telecom is deploying into them; the document gives no opening date, so as_of is its publication date.

Raxio says its Luanda carrier-neutral data centre is Tier III certified, the first independent carrier-neutral one in Angola to be so; the document does not name the certifying body, and the as_of is the publication date.

note: carried from datacentres; no document opened
